determinism_argument.why: under do_sample=False with a fixed seed and use_cache=True, token t depends only on tokens 0..t-1, so a higher upper bound cannot alter any token the 512-token run already produced; it only removes the stopping point

acceptance_criteria.on_any_failure: HARD STOP, return for review. Do not tune the ceiling again, do not modify the prompt or parser, do not start the study.

explicit_non_claims: NOT claimed that the raised ceiling eliminates missingness -- validation pending; any residual unparsed responses are reported, never imputed

NOT claimed that 30.6% is the production failure rate (n=6 tasks, non-random)
